title: Static Normalization Sandbox
intent: Normalize authorized minified material without executing untrusted code.
problem: Without parser-only normalization forbids dynamic execution and network access, the system can accept an outcome that is not justified by the static normalization sandbox contract.
context: This pattern addresses authorized minified code needs structural inspection; its concrete control is parser-only normalization forbids dynamic execution and network access.
forces: Correctness requires that untrusted scripts are never evaluated
Operational pressure can cause: parser confusion triggers executable fallback
solution: Implement parser-only normalization forbids dynamic execution and network access. Verify the anchored symbol `SandboxPolicyDenied` with `test_builds_fail_closed_policy_and_verifiable_attestation` before reuse.
security: The security boundary specifically rejects `parser confusion triggers executable fallback` and fails closed if the static normalization sandbox evidence cannot be verified.
privacy: For static normalization sandbox, persist only its decision identifiers and digests; exclude payload data unrelated to parser-only normalization forbids dynamic execution and network access.
reuse_constraints: Confirm the target still requires: authorized minified code needs structural inspection
Do not apply when: behavior can only be established by executing untrusted payloads
External Ethernian promotion signature remains mandatory
applies_when: authorized minified code needs structural inspection
not_when: behavior can only be established by executing untrusted payloads
